rows.counter-target-spell: The counter DESTINATIONS are correct (Arcane Denial to p0's graveyard, the countered Lightning Bolt to p1's graveyard; CR 701.5a) -- the round-1 defect row that claimed the countered spells move into the OPPOSING player's hand was withdrawn after a probe. The real divergence is delayed-trigger timing: at the counter's resolution, before any upkeep, p1 (the countered spell's controller) has ALREADY drawn a card (p1 hand [Wastes]; one Draw event for p1 in the counter's resolve), while CR 610.2 puts both draws at the beginning of the NEXT turn's upkeep. p0's hand 1 here is his own uncast Lightning Bolt -- the scenario's hand_size wants are CR-correct (p0 1, p1 0).
